statements.status_notes: Upstream GHSA-w6mq-4qpx-v7mh (https://github.com/rabbitmq/rabbitmq-server/security/advisories/GHSA-w6mq-4qpx-v7mh) covers AMQP 1.0 parser memory amplification through zero-width arrays. It lists the RabbitMQ 3.13 to 4.3 lines as affected, the newest fixed release it names is 4.3.4, and does not list the 4.4 series. In the v4.4.0 and v4.4.1 release tags of rabbitmq-server, deps/amqp10_common/src/amqp10_binary_parser.erl keeps an array of zero-width elements as an opaque constant-size value instead of materialising Count terms, so a frame of such arrays no longer expands in memory. This package installs the GPG-verified upstream rabbitmq-server-generic-unix release. Its only published build, on amd64 and arm64, is 4.4.1-0, which ships RabbitMQ 4.4.1 (in the amd64 build, its plugin directories are rabbit-4.4.1, rabbitmq_management-4.4.1, rabbitmq_auth_backend_oauth2-4.4.1 and amqp10_common-4.4.1). That build carries the fix, so the range is fixed at 4.4.1-0.

Upstream GHSA-w6mq-4qpx-v7mh (https://github.com/rabbitmq/rabbitmq-server/security/advisories/GHSA-w6mq-4qpx-v7mh) covers AMQP 1.0 parser memory amplification through zero-width arrays. It lists the RabbitMQ 3.13 to 4.3 lines as affected, the newest fixed release it names is 4.3.4, and does not list the 4.4 series. In the v4.4.0 and v4.4.1 release tags of rabbitmq-server, deps/amqp10_common/src/amqp10_binary_parser.erl keeps an array of zero-width elements as an opaque constant-size value instead of materialising Count terms, so a frame of such arrays no longer expands in memory. This package installs the GPG-verified upstream rabbitmq-server-generic-unix release. Its published builds, on amd64 and arm64, are 4.4.0-0, which ships RabbitMQ 4.4.0 (in the amd64 build, its plugin directories are rabbit-4.4.0, rabbitmq_management-4.4.0, rabbitmq_auth_backend_oauth2-4.4.0 and amqp10_common-4.4.0), and 4.4.1-0, 4.4.1-1 and 4.4.1-2, which ship RabbitMQ 4.4.1. Every published build carries the fix, so the range starts fixed at the lowest one, 4.4.0-0.
